results.title: New free-to-play MMORPG, currently topping Steam charts, has an English store page but no English support
results.description: Longevity: Path of the Immortal is trending on Steam with English copy, but interestingly, no English support whatsoever. The game supports Simplified Chinese only, and Steam does outright flag this with a warning. It currently has "Very Positive" reviews, but almost none of them are English.

results.title: Sheffield United owner breaks silence on points deduction threat
results.description: Sheffield United owner Steven Rosen has dismissed speculation that the club could be given a 12-point deduction.
